issue_context.title: Move Pod Affinity priority logic to its Score plugin [Migration Phase 2]
issue_context.body:
/assign @ahg-g 
/sig scheduling
/priority important-soon

This includes moving the metadata logic into PostFilter.

Part of #85822

review_comments: is there a PR coming to unfold things in PodAffinityChecker?
yes, moving the filter logic will be in a separate PR.
is this so that scheduler policies don't fail?

yeah, this is because we want to keep this priority **key** registered, the logic downstream will basically look at the registered keys and configure the scheduler with plugins. This will be cleaned up later.
